text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls). Both home all day Sunday.

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key changes observed on Monday:

Entry:
- Aisha’s items (backpack, headphones, jacket, keys, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, shoes, wallet, water bottle) returned to entry hooks/table/floor at 20:00.
- Felix’s items (backpack, charger, headphones, jacket, laptop, scarf, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle, umbrella) returned to entry hooks/table/floor/shoe rack at 20:00.
- Shared: toolbox, vacuum cleaner on floor.

Kitchen:
- Counter: kettle, knife block, toaster, wall clock, vitamins (Felix), cutting board, kitchen knife, pan, spatula, shopping bag.
- Cupboard: duster, lunchbox (Felix), mug (Aisha), plate (Felix), bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), snack bowl, mug (Felix), plate (Aisha), glass (Aisha), serving dish.
- Table: fruit bowl, plate (Aisha), water bottle (Felix).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, glass (Felix), plate (Aisha), bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), mug (Aisha).
- Dish rack: glass (Aisha), plate (Aisha), plate (Felix), water bottle (Felix).
- Drawer: empty.
- Pantry: empty.

Living:
- Couch: blanket, cushion 1, knitting bag (Felix).
- Coffee table: candle, coasters, tissue box.
- Bookshelf: board game, picture frame, speaker, vase.
- TV stand: remote.
- Side table: lamp.
- Armchair: cushion 2.

Bedroom 1:
- Nightstand: books (Aisha, Felix), tablets (Aisha, Felix), tablet (Felix), phone (Aisha), phone (Felix).
- Desk: laptop (Aisha), glasses (Aisha).
- Dresser: empty.
- Floor: ironing board.
- Bed: hair dryer (Felix).
- Wardrobe: empty.

Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent, laundry basket, skincare (Aisha), skincare (Felix), towel (Felix).
- Medicine cabinet: medication (Aisha).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, razor (Aisha, Felix).
- Towel rack: towels (Aisha).

Balcony:
- Floor: watering can.
- Table: spray bottle, gardening gloves.

Office:
- All spots empty.

Notes:
- Aisha’s and Felix’s work/errand items (laptops, bags, keys, phones, etc.) are out during the day and returned to entry/bedroom by evening.
- Kitchen utensils (knife, spatula, cutting board) move between drawer/counter/sink/pantry during meal prep/cleanup.
- Shared dishes (plates, pans, serving dishes) move from cupboard to table during meals.
- Water bottles appear in kitchen/entry when residents are home.
- Phones are not tracked in patrols (likely in pockets/bags) but were seen on nightstand/coffee table at night.
